question:
**Direction: Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A unit to measure light
solution:
Here, the correct answer is "Lumen."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
__
 
• A** "lumen" **is a unit of measurement used to quantify the amount of visible light emitted by a source or received by a surface. (माप की एक इकाई जिसका उपयोग किसी स्रोत द्वारा उत्सर्जित या किसी सतह द्वारा प्राप्त दृश्य प्रकाश की मात्रा को मापने के लिए किया जाता है)
 
• It is a measure of luminous flux, which represents the total amount of light energy emitted per unit of time. In simpler terms, lumens measure the brightness of a light source.
 
 
• **Example**: *I bought a new LED bulb that emits 1000 **lumens**__, providing bright and energy-efficient lighting for my room.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• Watt: a unit of electrical power. (विद्युत शक्ति की इकाई; वाट)
 
• Horse-power: the common unit of power. (शक्ति की सामान्य इकाई)
 
• Ampere: a unit of measure of the rate of electron flow or current in an electrical conductor. (किसी विद्युत चालक में इलेक्ट्रॉन प्रवाह या धारा की दर मापने की एक इकाई)
